verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own docs cite a "generous free tier" as a differentiator against Calendly, and a cofounder says everything that is PRO on Calendly is free on Cal.com. The product's core is sharing a booking link, and a community user reports happily using it. The only community pricing gripe found is that premium vanity usernames cost $29/month, which does not block a usable standard booking link. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party pricing page detailing free-tier limits, and independent hands-on confirmation that a hosted free account gets a working personal booking link.
